description: This file defines the EmployeeTerminationRecord entity class for the OrangeHRM system. It models employee termination records, including fields such as termination date, note, termination reason, and the associated employee. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes methods to access and modify the entity's properties.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationRecord
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's termination record, including termination date, notes, reason, and associated employee.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the termination record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the termination record.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the note associated with the termination.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note associated with the termination.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee associated with this termination record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with this termination record.
